remarks: OFFER DEADLINE MONDAY, JULY 15 AT 6PM. Picture perfect updated Colonial in ideal East Norwalk location. Generous sized rooms on the 1st floor include a light and bright living room, separate dining room, and updated kitchen with NEW backsplash and countertops. Hardwood floors in each room. Pristine powder room is centrally located between the kitchen and the dining rom. A separate vestibule ideal for storage or mudroom leads to the connecting deck, perfect for dining, or entertaining. Upstairs are 3 nicely sized bedrooms, full bathroom and large attic with storage galore. Partially finished basement is ideal for playroom, office, gym, choice is yours. Remaining room in the lower level hosts the washer/dryer, more storage and a one car garage. Among the many updates include: NEW central air along with 2 splits; NEW powder room tile, NEW hot water heater, NEW boiler, NEW gutters. Surrounded by a beautifully landscaped perimeter, complete with gorgeous fully fenced in yard. Come and see before it's gone!
